name: frontend-dependency-contract
body: Each of the seven apg language frontends (Go, Java, C++, Rust, TypeScript/JavaScript, C#, Python) plus the bundled structural scanner (Markdown, shell, YAML, JSON, TOML, XML, Dockerfile, Makefile, INI) must have its dependency contract stated in the durable spec: (a) its build-time dependencies, (b) its scan-time dependencies (what must exist on PATH when a user runs `apg scan`), and (c) the pinned engine whose version sets the language-version ceiling. The declaration is attached to that scanner's solution container, whose body names the code units that carry each dependency, so "to scan X you need Y and Z" is answerable and traceable from the spec. The contract is declarative: delivery is the container bodies plus the durable dependency-matrix note, and the change-set's only code delta is the documentation update claimed by `solution.component.frontend-dependency-docs` (README.md / AGENTS.md). The per-language frontend containers and the build pipeline carry no `implemented-by` claim — for them this change-set does not change frontend or build code, and their absence from the code-coverage surface is deliberate so the verify gate does not demand `modifies` tasks over untouched code; the bundled structural scanner added in 0.17.0 does carry `implemented-by` claims, since it is new code. (Before this change-set only four of the eight frontends had containers — go/java/ts/py — and none named its build-time deps, scan-time deps, or engine pin. 0.17.0 retires the separate Markdown frontend into the bundled structural scanner, so the set becomes seven frontends plus the bundle.)
